data.summary: An independent validation of the Random‑forest PD challenger benchmark was performed to assess its predictive power and compliance. The Gini — train, Gini — test, Gini — out‑of‑time (simulated), KS — out‑of‑time, AUC — hold‑out, Brier score — hold‑out, Predicted × observed — hold‑out, Observed outcome rate — hold‑out, Approval rate at coded cutoff, Champion Gini — hold‑out, and Challenger Gini — hold‑out metrics are reported as {{m:run_66dc13:gini.train}}, {{m:run_66dc13:gini.test}}, {{m:run_66dc13:gini.oot}}, {{m:run_66dc13:ks.oot}}, {{m:run_66dc13:auc.holdout}}, {{m:run_66dc13:brier.holdout}}, {{m:run_66dc13:calibration_ratio.holdout}}, {{m:run_66dc13:bad_rate.holdout}}, {{m:run_66dc13:approval_rate.holdout}}, {{m:run_66dc13:gini.champion.holdout}}, and {{m:run_66dc13:gini.challenger.holdout}} respectively. The validation identified high‑severity findings count as {{m:run_66dc13:findings.high}}, medium‑severity findings count as {{m:run_66dc13:findings.medium}}, and total findings count as {{m:run_66dc13:findings.total}}. The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
